cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Reopen the First Reason
cards.instruction: Keep them present by returning to the first reason for staying and revealing that it now means something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're having a proper goodbye. Stay until your tea cools; I'll take your coat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The tea's cold. Give me my coat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep it on, then. I meant stay long enough to finish a cup with me, not stand by the door holding one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can sit for two minutes, but don't make another pot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No pot. Bring the cold cup over here; I haven't finished saying goodbye.

reason: Replace declared authority with management of coat and tea; B limits the delay and A accepts that limit while changing what finishing tea means.
